meta.title: ERP Assignee Auto-Mapping: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and attempt ERP Assignee Auto-Mapping when no rule exists, observing whether the action is refused or absent.
Repeat the ERP Assignee Auto-Mapping attempt as a Buyer and verify that it is available and succeeds.
Verify the tenant's Growth plan and determine whether RBAC deliberately grants the action to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and attempt ERP Assignee Auto-Mapping when no rule exists, observing whether the action is refused or absent.; Repeat the ERP Assignee Auto-Mapping attempt as a Buyer and verify that it is available and succeeds.; Verify the tenant's Growth plan and determine whether RBAC deliberately grants the action to additional roles.

steps.note: Reach the Purchase Requisitions area before the role-specific ERP assignee mapping attempt.
Use an open purchase request as the starting record for the mapping attempt.

args.need: sign in as the non-Buyer user and then as a Buyer on the same tenant, attempt ERP Assignee Auto-Mapping for an open PR with no rule, and report whether the action is absent or refused for the non-Buyer and available for the Buyer
